name: skin-hydration-cells
description: Skin hydration cells - procedural Three.js motion graphic for Remotion (two 4K compositions)

scripts.render:v1: remotion render SkinHydration-V1-Reference-4K "out/Version 1 - Skin Hydration Cells (Reference Match) - 1080p.mp4" --scale=0.5 --muted
scripts.render:v2: remotion render SkinHydration-V2-CameraMove-4K "out/Version 2 - Skin Hydration Cells (Camera Move) - 1080p.mp4" --scale=0.5 --muted
scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render SkinHydration-V1-Reference-4K "out/Version 1 - Skin Hydration Cells (Reference Match) - 4K.mp4" --muted
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render SkinHydration-V2-CameraMove-4K "out/Version 2 - Skin Hydration Cells (Camera Move) - 4K.mp4" --muted
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
